input.summary: Add a once-per-year cap and 15 days' notice to Array's inspection rights and fix the audit-cost threshold at 10% underpayment.
input.comment: [Playbook] We can accept Array's inspection and audit rights, but they need the usual guardrails: a once-per-year cap and at least 15 days' prior written notice for the Section 4.9 facility inspection (today it is unlimited in frequency on merely "reasonable" notice), the same 15 days' notice for the Section 7.4 records inspection, and confirmation that Array bears inspection costs unless an underpayment exceeds 10%.

ops.oldText: Such inspections may be made no more than once each Calendar Year, at reasonable times and on reasonable prior written notice.
ops.newText: Such inspections may be made no more than once each Calendar Year, at reasonable times and on at least fifteen (15) days' prior written notice.
exceeding ten percent (10%) of the amount paid

ops.oldText: permit Array, and/or an authorized representative reasonably acceptable to Ono, to enter the relevant facilities of Ono and its Affiliates during normal business hours and upon reasonable advance notice
ops.newText: permit Array, and/or an authorized representative reasonably acceptable to Ono, to enter the relevant facilities of Ono and its Affiliates during normal business hours, no more than once per year and upon at least fifteen (15) days' prior written notice
